faq.question: What are your hurricane preparedness measures?
faq.answer: Our facility is constructed with reinforced steel and hurricane-rated doors. All indoor units are fully enclosed. We recommend tenants check their contents before and after a major storm.

faq.question: What sizes of boats can you store?
faq.answer: Our 10x30 boat bays can accommodate watercraft up to approximately 28 feet. Please call us to confirm your specific vessel dimensions before reserving.

faq.question: Are indoor units air-conditioned?
faq.answer: Yes, our 10x10 and 10x15 indoor units are climate-controlled to stay between 65–80°F — ideal for protecting furniture, electronics, and sensitive items from Florida's heat and humidity.
